{{Quote|Well done, soldier.|Daric LaRone, saluting the dead Troukree|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A '''Troukree''' was among a group of fellow [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by their spokesman, [[Vaantaar]], who had been displaced from their [[Troukree homeworld|homeworld]] by the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. [[0 ABY/Legends|Eight]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Troukree and their comrades accompanied Vaantaar to aid the group of rogue [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] known as the [[Hand of Judgment]] in the defense of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]], which was similarly being threatened by Esva. During a [[Battle for Poln Major|fight]] against Esva's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in [[Whitestone City]], the Troukree [[Death/Legends|died]] when they used their own body to shield the leader of the Hand of Judgment, [[Daric LaRone]], from the fire of an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Thrawn|As for what you accomplished, you helped save the life of a good and valuable man, along with the lives of his family.|Brightwater|At the cost of another being's life.|Vaantaar|Which he was more than willing to give. As were we all.|attr=Thrawn, Korlo Brightwater, and Vaantaar, thinking back to the events on Poln Major|src=<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-DB.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Senior Captain Thrawn]]
A [[Troukree]], along with a group of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] of their [[Species/Legends|species]], fled from their [[Troukree homeworld|homeworld]] after it was threatened by the advances of [[Nuso Esva]], an [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. At some point<ref name="Choices" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Refuge">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. As the [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] were on [[Poln Major]] during the novel's events, they must have traveled there by 0 ABY.</ref> the Troukree refugees settled on [[Poln Major]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the group's stay on Poln Major, the leader of the refugees, [[Vaantaar]], also acted as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Empire of the Hand]]. On Poln Major, the Troukree refugee joined Vaantaar in helping the [[Hand of Judgment]], a group of five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserters, to protect Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] against [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts organized by Esva's elite [[Soldier/Legends|troops]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]]. The Governor's [[Death/Legends|death]] was intended to be bait to lure Thrawn into a [[Battle of the Poln system|trap]] prepared by Esva in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. In the basement of the [[Whistling Wind]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] in [[Whitestone City]], two members of the Hand of Judgment, [[Joak Quiller]] and [[Korlo Brightwater]], taught basic stormtrooper battle tactics to their Troukree allies, while [[Daric LaRone]] and [[Saberan Marcross]], two other stormtroopers, fought off the [[Battle for Poln Major|first attack]] against their sanctuary.<ref name="Choices" />

During the second attack, the Troukree sacrificed their life to shield LaRone, the stormtroopers' leader, from the fire of an enemy [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] with their own body&mdash;one of the [[Unidentified Troukree (jump assistance)|Troukree's companions]] helped them to jump over LaRone's head as the stormtrooper approached the weapon, thus providing cover. The defenders fought off three attacks against their sanctuary, losing only the Troukree that had shielded LaRone during the second wave, before Troukree reinforcements arrived outside the tapcafe. Their sacrifice deeply touched the stormtroopers, as they had not expected an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] to risk their life to protect a [[Human/Legends|Human]]. The act later contributed to their decision to accept Thrawn's offer to join him to train a [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|new strain of stormtroopers]], who would accept aliens into their ranks and which was named after the Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Our skill is with our knives. In a space so confined, that is all we shall need.|Vaantaar, referring to the Troukree's fighting ability|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Like the other Troukree warriors following Vaantaar, the Troukree was experienced with [[Troukree knife|knives]] in close-quarters combat. They were also skilled in acrobatics, a talent they used to enhance their combat performance and to jump high into the air with the help of a companion when protecting LaRone against an E-Web [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]]. During their [[Time/Legends|time]] with the Hand of Judgment, the Troukree received additional training in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons from Quiller and Brightwater. The Troukree was willing to sacrifice his life to ensure that LaRone's attempt to destroy the E-Web threat was successful. They had [[Color/Legends|green]], scaly skin, with patches of [[Hair/Legends|fur]] of the same color.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Troukree appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
